Title:MAIN AND DEVELOPMENT ESTIMATES
MPs Speaking:Mr Tan Soo Khoon (Mr Speaker);


Column: 339

[Mr Speaker in the Chair]

MAIN AND DEVELOPMENT ESTIMATES
(Announcement by Mr Speaker)


    Mr Speaker: In accordance with the provisions of paragraph (7) of Standing Order 87 and paragraph (5) of Standing Order 88, I have fixed the times for the conclusion of consideration of the heads of expenditure in the Main and Development Estimates of Expenditure for FY 1991/1992 in the Committee of Supply.

    These times have been notified to hon. Members and will appear in the Official Report. (Cols. 395 - 398)
Committee of Supply - MAIN AND DEVELOPMENT ESTIMATES OF EXPENDITURE FOR THE FINANCIAL YEAR 1ST APRIL, 1991 TO 31ST MARCH, 1992 (Cols. 395 - 398)
